name: National Family Benefit Scheme- Uttarakhand
benefit: A one-time financial assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided to the family in the event of the death of the primary earning member.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a family member of the deceased primary breadwinner. 1. The deceased primary breadwinner must have been a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The family must be classified under the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The deceased must have been between 18 and 59 years of age at the time of death.
